execution_flows.name: 1. Startup Route Compilation & Dependant DAG Construction
execution_flows.trigger: Decorator registration (`@app.get`, `@router.post`, `app.include_router`) during module import / startup
steps: FastAPI / APIRouter creates an APIRoute (or APIWebSocketRoute) in fastapi/routing.py.

APIRoute.__init__ calls get_dependant() and analyze_param() in fastapi/dependencies/utils.py using typing-inspection to classify path, query, header, cookie, body, Depends(), and Security() parameters.
Body parameters are synthesized into composite Pydantic v2 ModelField / TypeAdapter validators via fastapi/_compat/v2.py.
APIRoute.get_route_handler() pre-builds the async ASGI request_response closure via get_request_handler().

execution_flows.name: 2. ASGI HTTP / SSE Request Dispatch, DI Resolution & Yield Teardown
execution_flows.trigger: Incoming ASGI HTTP scope delivered to FastAPI.__call__(scope, receive, send)
steps: NativeTelemetry (when enabled) and ServerErrorMiddleware / user ASGI middlewares / ExceptionMiddleware / AsyncExitStackMiddleware wrap the request.
Starlette Router matches APIRoute and invokes the pre-compiled get_request_handler() closure in fastapi/routing.py.
Request body (JSON, Form, or Multipart) is parsed and solve_dependencies() executes the Dependant DAG with per-request dependency_cache and AsyncExitStack registration for yield dependencies.
run_endpoint_function() dispatches async def callables directly on the event loop or offloads sync def callables via Starlette/AnyIO run_in_threadpool.

serialize_response() validates/filters return payloads via Pydantic v2 ModelField (or streams EventSourceResponse / JSONL), sends ASGI response frames, unwinds request-scoped yield dependencies in AsyncExitStackMiddleware, and runs BackgroundTasks.

execution_flows.name: 3. Lazy OpenAPI 3.1.0 Schema Synthesis & Interactive Docs Serving
execution_flows.trigger: First GET request to /openapi.json (or explicit app.openapi() call) and /docs or /redoc
steps: FastAPI.openapi() checks cached self.openapi_schema; on cache miss, invokes get_openapi() in fastapi/openapi/utils.py.
get_fields_from_routes() collects all ModelField instances across routes and dependencies, generating unified JSON Schema $defs via GenerateJsonSchema in fastapi/_compat/v2.py.
get_openapi_path() synthesizes paths, operationIds, security schemes, requestBody, and status-code responses into an OpenAPI 3.1.0 dictionary cached on app.openapi_schema.
fastapi/openapi/docs.py renders Swagger UI (/docs) or ReDoc (/redoc) HTML pointing to openapi_url.

state_and_storage: In-Memory Application Metadata: FastAPI instance holds registered APIRoute list, dependency_overrides dict, middleware definitions, and lazy-cached self.openapi_schema dict (no database or filesystem state).

Per-Request Ephemeral Scope State: scope['fastapi_inner_astack'] & scope['fastapi_function_astack'] (AsyncExitStack instances managing function-scoped vs request-scoped yield teardown) plus per-request dependency_cache dict keyed by (call, tuple(security_scopes)).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Asynchronous ASGI 3.0 event-loop concurrency backed by AnyIO: `async def` endpoints and dependencies execute directly on the active asyncio/trio loop, whereas synchronous `def` endpoints and sync contextmanager `yield` dependencies (`contextmanager_in_threadpool` in `fastapi/concurrency.py`) are automatically offloaded to AnyIO worker threads to prevent event-loop blocking. Validation failures raise `RequestValidationError` / `WebSocketRequestValidationError` / `ResponseValidationError` (`fastapi/exceptions.py`), translated into structured 422 JSON payloads by `fastapi/exception_handlers.py`.

audit_dimensions.summary: Across 52 Python modules (19,837 LOC, 121 classes, 438 functions), FastAPI v0.162.2 demonstrates exceptional security and typing discipline: 94.5% callable type safety coverage, packaged PEP 561 py.typed, PEP 727 Annotated[..., Doc()] inline parameter documentation (annotated_doc), zero wildcard imports, zero empty or mismatched docstrings, zero hardcoded secrets, and zero dangerous CWE execution sinks. findings.description: get_openapi_path merges operation parameters, request bodies, security scopes, callbacks, and multi-status response schemas in one monolithic routine.
findings.recommendation: Factor response-schema assembly and callback operation generation into composable helper functions.

findings.evidence: length=408 lines, branches=49, cognitive=159 (inner app closure at line 428: cognitive=157)
findings.description: get_request_handler embeds body parsing (JSON, multipart, form, raw), solve_dependencies execution, endpoint dispatch, streaming/SSE branching, and response validation inside a single nested closure.
findings.recommendation: Extract dedicated helper stages (_parse_request_body, _execute_solved_endpoint, _build_validated_response) while preserving closure pre-computation for hot-path performance.

findings.evidence: CVE-2026-114605 (HIGH, CVSS 7.5): dnspython 2.8.0 in uv.lock (fixed in 2.9.0; transitive dependency of optional email-validator)
findings.description: Transitive optional/dev lockfile entry dnspython@2.8.0 in uv.lock is affected by CVE-2026-114605 (DNS compression pointer DoS). Core fastapi wheel installations are unaffected because pyproject.toml does not pin dnspython.
findings.recommendation: Run `uv lock --upgrade-package dnspython` in upstream maintenance cycles to bump locked dnspython from 2.8.0 to >=2.9.0.

findings.description: Runtime circular import loop between fastapi._compat.v2, fastapi.params, and fastapi.datastructures mitigated via deferred import ordering.
findings.recommendation: Guard type-only UploadFile / FieldInfo cross-references under TYPE_CHECKING or extract shared sentinel types into fastapi.types.

findings.description: ModelField.validate declares a mutable dict literal default (values: dict[str, Any] = {}) rather than None.
findings.recommendation: Default values to None and normalize to {} or MappingProxyType inside the method body to prevent accidental shared-dict mutation.

findings.description: Standalone showcase repository snapshot omits upstream GitHub governance files (SECURITY.md and .github/dependabot.yml).
findings.recommendation: If operating this showcase repository continuously, add a SECURITY.md pointing upstream FastAPI security reports to github.com/fastapi/fastapi/security and configure Dependabot for GitHub Actions.

findings.evidence: with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True): ... contains no assert on captured warnings
findings.description: test_old_multipart_installed records warnings with catch_warnings(record=True) when python_multipart=='0.0.12' is monkeypatched, but omits asserting on the captured warning list.
findings.recommendation: Bind `with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as recorded:` and assert the expected warning or clean registration behavior explicitly.

findings.evidence: 29 missing annotations (primarily __init__ -> None return annotations in fastapi/params.py and fastapi/datastructures.py) and 5 unscoped # type: ignore comments
findings.description: Several parameter descriptor __init__ methods omit explicit -> None return annotations, and 5 # type: ignore comments omit specific error codes.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit -> None return annotations on descriptor __init__ methods and scope remaining # type: ignore[code] directives.

action_plan.title: Decompose high-complexity request handler and OpenAPI path synthesis routines
action_plan.action: Factor body extraction, dependency execution, and response serialization helpers out of get_request_handler (cognitive=159) in fastapi/routing.py and split response/callback schema builders out of get_openapi_path (cognitive=109) in fastapi/openapi/utils.py.
action_plan.expected_impact: Reduces cognitive complexity hotspots toward <= 25 while preserving FastAPI's route-registration pre-computation speed.

action_plan.title: Bump transitive dnspython>=2.9.0 in uv.lock and refresh test harness base image
action_plan.action: Upgrade locked transitive `dnspython` from `2.8.0` to `>=2.9.0` via `uv lock --upgrade-package dnspython` (closing `CVE-2026-114605`) and run `apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y` or switch to `trixie-slim` in `.pni/dockerfiles/root/Dockerfile` for hermetic CI runs.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates the single HIGH transitive uv.lock advisory and reduces test-harness OS base-image CVE noise.

action_plan.title: Break runtime import cycle across _compat.v2, params, and datastructures and re-export telemetry facade
action_plan.action: Move runtime UploadFile/sentinel checks or guard under TYPE_CHECKING to eliminate the _compat.v2 <-> params -> datastructures cycle, and expose internal telemetry entrypoints via fastapi/telemetry/__init__.py.
action_plan.expected_impact: Achieves zero runtime circular dependencies across all 52 modules and clean subpackage boundary encapsulation.

action_plan.title: Add showcase SECURITY.md and GitHub Actions Dependabot configuration
action_plan.action: Add a concise SECURITY.md redirecting FastAPI vulnerability disclosures to the official upstream FastAPI Security Advisories page, and add .github/dependabot.yml for CI workflow maintenance.
action_plan.expected_impact: Satisfies OpenSSF Scorecard repository governance checks while clearly routing framework security disclosures upstream.

action_plan.title: Add explicit warning assertion in test_old_multipart_installed
action_plan.action: Capture `as w` on `warnings.catch_warnings(record=True)` in `tests/test_multipart_installation.py:141` and assert expected warning count/message.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates silent assertion-free test pass if multipart version warning behavior regresses.

action_plan.title: Replace mutable dict default in ModelField.validate and scope remaining type: ignore comments
action_plan.action: Replace values: dict[str, Any] = {} with values: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None in fastapi/_compat/v2.py:176, add -> None on Param.__init__ subclasses, and attach explicit [error-code] brackets to the 5 unscoped # type: ignore comments.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates B006 mutable-default hazard and raises callable annotation completeness above 99%.
